overview.description: The North Square Growth Opportunities ETF (NSIG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of US large- and mid-cap equities and equity-related securities that are fundamentally selected based on consideration for higher-than-average growth potential.   NSIG was launched on Jul 9, 2026 and is issued by North Square.

data.text: CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)---- $NSIG--North Square Investments today announced the launch of North Square Disciplined Value ETF (NSIV) and North Square Growth Opportunities ETF (NSIG).
